prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production game sprite for a 2D top-down arcade game. Create ONE circular collectible orb housing, centered on a genuinely transparent alpha background, square canvas. A refined pearlescent white and silver glass energy ring with a subtly luminous milky glass interior, delicate concentric bevel, restrained soft halo, tiny sharp highlight at upper left. Perfectly circular, front-on orthographic view, outer physical circle occupies exactly 75 percent of canvas width, generous transparent padding. Center is clean and quiet for a colored weapon glyph to be drawn by the game. Neutral white/silver only so the engine can tint it amber, cyan, violet or green. Readable at 36 pixels; bold simple silhouette, polished elegant arcade collectible, neither noisy sci-fi machinery nor a realistic planet. No text, no letters, no symbol in the center, no shadow cast onto a surface, no background, no checkerboard. High quality antialiased edges with actual alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production sprite for a 2D top-down tilt survival arcade game. Single perfectly round scarlet-red enemy bead centered on a transparent alpha background, square canvas. Front-on orthographic circular disk, vivid coral-red center, deeper crimson thin outer rim, a small crisp creamy highlight on the upper-left curve, restrained red glow. The solid body is 75 percent of canvas width with generous transparent margin. Polished and graphic, extremely simple and legible at 12 pixels, no face, no eyes, no spokes, no star, no lettering, no scenery, no floor shadow. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard. Original elegant arcade art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE additive particle texture for 2D game VFX. A single luminous white energy spark centered on an actual transparent alpha background, square canvas. Tiny intense white core, short tapered four-point star rays, perfectly smooth radial falloff to transparent, a faint round white halo occupying 70 percent of canvas, symmetrical and delicate. White monochrome only, intended to be color-tinted and scaled by SpriteKit for missile trails, ice fragments and explosions. Strong compact core, no enormous lens streaks, no smoke, no text, no scene, no checkerboard. Crisp polished arcade particle sprite.
